settings.info: CaddieInsight loads Archivo, Archivo Expanded and DM Mono in theme.liquid to match the app. This picker is retained for theme editor compatibility only.

settings.content: Archivo Expanded carries display type and Archivo the interface — the wordmark's own superfamily. DM Mono marks measured evidence (chips, dosages, specimen labels). The same three faces ship on app.caddieinsight.com, byte for byte.
